svg.title: pysad scoring a stream as it arrives
svg.desc: Three sensor readings stream in from left to right. A Robust Random Cut Forest scores each point as it arrives, and conformal calibration raises an alert (red) at p at most 0.005: at a spike on sensor 1, a level shift on sensor 2 and a dip on sensor 3. Synthetic data.
svg.text: 3 sensors, one point at a time
calibrated anomaly score: Robust Random Cut Forest + conformal p-value
synthetic 3-sensor stream · 1,200 points · higher = more anomalous
